__meta.dataType: MANUAL-DUMMY — compute weekly from INCOIS PFZ + IMD warnings
__meta.realDataset: NEW-4 — Derived Risk Index from INCOIS PFZ advisories + IMD warnings
__meta.howToUpdate: Each week: (1) Count INCOIS PFZ 'no fishing' sectors. (2) Count IMD red/orange fishermen warnings. (3) Compute avgQuotaUtil from /api/species. Apply formula. Normalise. Append new week entry. Change dataType to MANUAL-LIVE.
